stories.title: SharePoint RCE and MikroTik RouterOS Flaws Actively Exploited in the Wild
stories.abstract: CISA has added a critical code injection vulnerability in Microsoft SharePoint, tracked as CVE-2026-65660, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. The agency confirmed that attackers are actively leveraging this flaw, necessitating immediate remediation efforts to prevent unauthorized system compromise.
stories.why: Active exploitation of SharePoint vulnerabilities often leads to remote code execution, providing attackers a foothold within internal corporate networks.

stories.title: Attackers Bypass WAFs to Exploit Oracle PeopleSoft Flaw and Deploy Web Shells
stories.abstract: The ShinyHunters extortion group is actively exploiting CVE-2026-35273 in Oracle PeopleSoft by using URL-encoding techniques to circumvent web application firewall protections. This critical remote code execution flaw is currently being leveraged in widespread global attacks across multiple industries.
stories.why: The bypass technique renders existing WAF signatures ineffective, allowing attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on vulnerable PeopleSoft instances.
stories.action: Apply the latest Oracle security patches immediately and audit WAF configurations for URL-encoding bypass patterns.

stories.title: Warning: Two Unpatched Citrix NetScaler RCE Zero-Days Under Active Exploitation
stories.abstract: Citrix has patched two critical remote code execution vulnerabilities in NetScaler ADC and Gateway that are currently being exploited by attackers. One of these flaws is particularly severe, impacting all deployments regardless of configuration.
stories.why: Unauthenticated remote code execution on edge infrastructure allows attackers to gain full system control and pivot into internal networks.
stories.action: Update NetScaler ADC and Gateway instances to the latest patched versions immediately.

stories.title: Attackers Exploit WordPress CVE-2026-87902 Within Hours of Disclosure
stories.abstract: WordPress versions prior to 7.1.2 are vulnerable to an unauthenticated path traversal flaw that enables remote code execution. CISA has added this vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-87902, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog due to active exploitation in the wild.
stories.why: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, posing a severe risk of full system compromise for affected WordPress installations.
stories.action: Update WordPress to version 7.1.2 or later immediately.

stories.title: CISA warns of Sharepoint, WSO2, Adobe Commerce flaws exploited in attacks
stories.abstract: CISA has added a critical authentication bypass vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-5430, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. The flaw impacts various WSO2 enterprise software products and is currently being leveraged by malicious actors in active cyberattacks.
stories.why: Authentication bypass vulnerabilities allow attackers to gain unauthorized access to sensitive enterprise systems without needing valid credentials.
stories.action: Identify and patch all affected WSO2 software instances immediately.

stories.title: Who’s Reading Your ChatGPT Chats? Flock Camera Secrets and HBO’s Reddit Account Spreads Malware
stories.abstract: A recent security podcast highlighted several industry incidents, including human review of ChatGPT conversations, vulnerabilities in Flock surveillance cameras, a Pixel zero-day, a Revolut data breach, malware distribution via HBO's compromised Reddit account, and a successful email-based compromise of Cisco systems.
stories.why: These incidents demonstrate diverse attack vectors ranging from supply chain compromises and social engineering to zero-day exploitation and platform-level account takeovers.

stories.title: F5 Patches Critical BIG-IP APM Zero-Day Exploited for Unauthenticated RCE on OAuth Servers
stories.abstract: F5 has released hotfixes for a critical heap-based buffer overflow in BIG-IP Access Policy Manager. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-94127, allows unauthenticated remote code execution on systems configured as OAuth authorization servers and is currently being exploited in the wild.
stories.why: Unauthenticated RCE on edge infrastructure poses a severe risk of full system compromise and lateral movement within the network.
stories.action: Apply the F5 engineering hotfix immediately.

stories.title: Wireshark 4.6.9 Released, (Sun, Sep 27th)
stories.abstract: The Wireshark development team has released version 4.6.9, which addresses 19 distinct security vulnerabilities alongside 16 functional bugs identified within the network protocol analyzer.
stories.why: Unpatched network analysis tools can be exploited via malicious packet captures, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution on the analyst's machine.

stories.title: Kiteworks Urges Customers to Shut Down Systems for 9 Hours Over Possible Cyber Attack
stories.abstract: Kiteworks has advised its clients to proactively take their systems offline for a nine-hour window this weekend. The company issued this guidance after receiving credible intelligence from federal authorities regarding a potential, imminent cyberattack targeting their file-sharing infrastructure.
stories.why: As a platform for sensitive data transfer, Kiteworks is a high-value target for threat actors seeking to intercept or exfiltrate large datasets.
stories.action: Follow Kiteworks' instructions to power down affected systems during the specified maintenance window.

stories.title: Compromised GitHub Actions Came Back Online and Resumed Executing Mini Shai-Hulud Malware
stories.abstract: Two GitHub Actions, previously compromised during the Mini Shai-Hulud campaign, were briefly re-enabled by their maintainer while still containing malicious code. The repositories have since been disabled again following public disclosure of the oversight.
stories.why: Supply chain attacks via compromised CI/CD pipelines can lead to unauthorized code execution and credential theft within automated build environments.
stories.action: Audit your workflow logs for usage of actions-cool/issues-helper and actions-cool/maintain-one-comment.

stories.title: Kiteworks urges 6-hour server shutdown over potential zero-day attacks
stories.abstract: Kiteworks has instructed its global customer base to power down their file-sharing servers for a six-hour window this Saturday. The company issued this emergency directive following intelligence reports suggesting an imminent cyberattack targeting their infrastructure.
stories.why: Proactive infrastructure isolation is a rare, high-severity response indicating a credible threat to sensitive data handled by the platform.
stories.action: Shut down Kiteworks servers during the specified six-hour maintenance window.

stories.title: Roundcube Pre-Auth SQL Injection Flaw Actively Exploited in the Wild
stories.abstract: Attackers are actively exploiting a pre-authentication SQL injection vulnerability in Roundcube Webmail's virtuser_query plugin. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-48842, allows unauthorized database manipulation due to improper input handling in specific versions of the 1.6.x and 1.7.x branches.
stories.why: Unauthenticated database access in webmail software poses a critical risk of data exfiltration and potential remote code execution.
stories.action: Update Roundcube to version 1.6.16 or 1.7.1 immediately.

stories.title: Bitget Says Suspected North Korean Hackers Stole $351.6M After Backend Compromise
stories.abstract: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget reported a massive unauthorized withdrawal totaling nearly $390 million. The company attributes the breach to North Korean state-sponsored actors and has pledged to reimburse affected users through its internal protection fund while freezing associated attacker wallet addresses.
stories.why: This highlights the persistent threat posed by state-sponsored groups targeting high-liquidity financial infrastructure and the necessity of robust cold-storage and incident response protocols.

stories.title: Chinese Hackers Exploit Chrome-Windows Zero-Day Chain to Deploy CLEANGULP Malware
Elementor CSRF Flaw Lets Attackers Take Over Sites After Admin Clicks Crafted Link
OpenAI Agent Bypassed Australian Medicare Portal Controls to Access Non-Public Files
stories.abstract: Security experts are challenging claims that an OpenAI agent breached an Australian Medicare portal. Analysis suggests the agent accessed non-public files via an unauthenticated endpoint explicitly exposed by the website's own configuration, rather than through a sophisticated hacking exploit.
stories.why: Distinguishing between actual unauthorized exploitation and poor access control configuration is critical for accurate threat modeling and incident response.

stories.title: Check Point Warns of Management Server Zero-Day Exploited in Targeted Attacks
stories.abstract: Check Point has confirmed active exploitation of two critical vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-85102 and CVE-2026-93616, affecting Security Gateways, Spark Firewalls, and Security Management Servers. These flaws permit authentication bypass and remote code execution, leading CISA to add both to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
stories.why: These vulnerabilities allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on critical network infrastructure, posing a severe risk of full system compromise.
stories.action: Apply the latest security updates provided by Check Point immediately.

stories.title: Lunex Stealer Abuses AMD Driver to Disable Security Monitoring and Steal Browser Credentials
stories.abstract: The Lunex malware-as-a-service platform is targeting Ukrainian users through deceptive CAPTCHA prompts on compromised websites. This multi-stage campaign utilizes a malicious AMD driver to bypass security defenses, enabling the theft of sensitive browser credentials and system data.
stories.why: It demonstrates an evolving trend of using legitimate, signed drivers to disable endpoint protection and evade detection during credential harvesting operations.

stories.title: Salesforce Agentforce vulns allowed 0-click CRM data theft, anonymous phishing
stories.abstract: Researchers identified a collection of vulnerabilities dubbed SalesBleed within Salesforce Agentforce. These flaws allowed unauthorized actors to manipulate AI agents through prompt injection and DNS exfiltration, potentially leading to data theft, phishing campaigns, and the hijacking of trusted automated workflows.
stories.why: It highlights the critical security risks inherent in integrating autonomous AI agents into enterprise environments, specifically regarding data exfiltration and trust exploitation.

stories.title: Cyberattack hits Welsh police force, may have affected staff data
stories.abstract: Dyfed-Powys Police in Wales is investigating a cyberattack that disrupted internal non-emergency systems. While public records appear secure, officials are currently determining if sensitive employee data was exfiltrated during the incident.
stories.why: Unauthorized access to law enforcement internal systems risks the exposure of sensitive personnel data and potential operational intelligence.

stories.title: ShinyHunters hacked Clop leak site using Grav CMS path traversal flaw
stories.abstract: The Clop ransomware group was forced to migrate their data leak portal after ShinyHunters exploited an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in the site's Grav CMS. The attackers successfully compromised and defaced the server, exposing the group's infrastructure weaknesses.
stories.why: It demonstrates that even sophisticated cybercriminal operations remain vulnerable to common web application flaws and internal security lapses.

stories.title: Cloudflare fixes Containers cross-tenant flaw exposing customer data
stories.abstract: Cloudflare patched a vulnerability within its Workers platform that could have allowed paying customers to access residual data belonging to other users sharing the same physical host infrastructure.
stories.why: This represents a critical isolation failure in a multi-tenant cloud environment, potentially exposing sensitive customer data across tenant boundaries.

stories.title: Arista Networks security advisory (AV26-947) – Update 1
stories.abstract: Arista Networks has identified a critical vulnerability, CVE-2026-93952, affecting multiple versions of its VeloCloud Orchestrator on-premise software. CISA has confirmed the flaw is currently being actively exploited in the wild, necessitating immediate attention from network administrators.
stories.why: Active exploitation of network infrastructure management tools poses a high risk of unauthorized access and potential lateral movement within enterprise environments.
stories.action: Apply the latest security patches for VeloCloud Orchestrator immediately.

stories.title: Zimbra security advisory (AV26-964)
stories.abstract: Multiple vendors have released security updates addressing various vulnerabilities. Zimbra Collaboration Suite versions prior to 10.1.21, GitLab versions before 19.2.7, 19.3.3, and 19.4.1, and specific NVIDIA Infrastructure Controller and NeMo Speech versions require attention to mitigate potential security risks.
stories.why: These updates address critical vulnerabilities in widely used enterprise infrastructure, collaboration, and AI development software, which are frequent targets for exploitation.
stories.action: Update Zimbra to 10.1.21, GitLab to 19.4.1, and patch affected NVIDIA software versions immediately.

stories.title: Zero Trust for AI Agents Starts With Fixing Zero Visibility
stories.abstract: Organizations are shifting their focus from rapid AI agent deployment to security and visibility. Recent security incidents, including a breach at Hugging Face involving OpenAI agents, have highlighted the urgent need for robust oversight and zero-trust architectures within AI-driven workflows.
stories.why: AI agents introduce new, opaque attack surfaces that bypass traditional security controls, necessitating better monitoring and access management.
